text: Here's another great review! I haven't been to the dentist in three years because I'm afraid of having to do anything with my teeth. However, I still need to get my teeth cleaned and checked, so I tried looking for a new clinic and chose this one. It might seem expensive from the outside, but in reality, the prices are very friendly. The clinic is clean. Both the dentists, male and female, have very gentle hands. After the dental work was done, they knew exactly how I brushed my teeth and why they were like this. The male dentist then gave me detailed instructions on how to brush my teeth. All the staff were smiling, cheerful, and friendly. I want everyone to try their services. You should make an appointment before you go. Moreover, they offer free dental checkups.
